ventkin.name: Ventkin
ventkin.tradeRule: Buys only goods that can get wet. Pays in brine jars, worth double at the dry worlds (Red Watchers, Wellkeepers).
ventkin.weakness: Can’t leave water, and warmth cooks them. Every trip needs a sealed jar or a suit.
ventkin.rival: Icecutters: both sell water from under the ice.

icecutters.name: Icecutters
icecutters.tradeRule: Only trades when the geysers fire (every other turn). Vent-cut ice is cheap, but it has to be delivered fast.
icecutters.weakness: Fresh-cut ice only keeps for one trip. A slow hauler delivers an empty jar.
icecutters.rival: Ventkin: both sell water from under the ice.

hazedrift.name: Hazedrift
hazedrift.tradeRule: Only takes cold cargo. Anything warm gets turned away at the dock.
hazedrift.weakness: Heat is deadly. They ride in a sealed pod to stay Titan-cold.
hazedrift.rival: Slagbacks: anything they handle comes back warm.

veilborn.name: Veilborn
veilborn.tradeRule: Pays top price for anything light enough to float. Won’t buy heavy goods, since they can’t lift them.
veilborn.weakness: Can’t drop below the clouds. Meet them up high or carry them in a sealed Lantern.
veilborn.rival: Red Watchers: Mars dust scratches their glass.

red-watchers.name: Red Watchers
red-watchers.tradeRule: Writes every price down and never changes it. Same price all game, boom or bust.
red-watchers.weakness: Planet-wide dust storms. Nobody lands until a storm passes.
red-watchers.rival: Wellkeepers: both count water and never get the same number.

slagbacks.name: Slagbacks
slagbacks.tradeRule: Pays double for heat-proof goods. Everything else catches fire on the dock.
slagbacks.weakness: Away from the vents it’s freezing. They travel in heat-holding canisters.
slagbacks.rival: Farfallen: fire and frost can’t share a hold.

wellkeepers.name: Wellkeepers
wellkeepers.tradeRule: Sells water, the rarest thing in the belt, by barter only: one jar for one good, no money. Their stores never run dry, so they can always sell.
wellkeepers.weakness: Nearly blind in daylight. They won’t leave the tunnels, so someone has to fly the jars out.
wellkeepers.rival: Starwake Comet: sells water cheap, then leaves.

farfallen.name: Farfallen
farfallen.tradeRule: Nitrogen ice is worth a lot, but it shrinks every turn it sits in your hold. Sell fast.
farfallen.weakness: Warmth. They ride only in insulated crates.

lodestars.name: Lodestars
lodestars.tradeRule: Escorts: they mark a safe path and ride along for a whole trip. Paid in metal, for repairs.
lodestars.weakness: They never stop. Far from a dock they run down and need a ride home.
lodestars.rival: Slagbacks: volcanic dust grinds into their joints.

edgewardens.name: Edgewardens
edgewardens.tradeRule: Charges a toll to cross the edge of the map. Paying gets you a weigh-stone that sets one good’s price for everyone.
edgewardens.weakness: The dim light. Without a lantern they lose the route.
edgewardens.rival: Starwake Comet: skips the toll every single time.

greylight.name: Greylight
greylight.tradeRule: Counts every crate. If you’re one short, the whole deal waits a turn.
greylight.weakness: Earth daylight blinds them, so they travel shaded.
greylight.rival: Ceti Highborn: their counts are suspiciously round.

bronzeridge.name: Bronzeridge
bronzeridge.tradeRule: Inspects your hold before any deal and fines you for missing paperwork.
bronzeridge.weakness: Cold-blooded. In a cold hold they slow to a stop, so they need a warm crate.
bronzeridge.rival: Mimics: their faces never match their papers.

ceti-highborn.name: Ceti Highborn
ceti-highborn.tradeRule: Pays late but pays extra. Every deal pays out one turn later, with a bonus.
ceti-highborn.weakness: Too tall for most holds. They ride in a big hold or their own Lantern.

darkreed.name: Darkreed
darkreed.tradeRule: Buys only in sets of 3, 6, or 9. Leftovers are refused.
darkreed.weakness: They molt once a season. Until the new shell hardens, they ride in a pod.
darkreed.rival: Amberhive: two crafter peoples, one set of market stalls.

the-kindled.name: The Kindled
the-kindled.tradeRule: Answers one question free each visit, like peeking at one face-down card or the next event.
the-kindled.weakness: Away from the lava’s glow they fade, so they need a Lantern.
the-kindled.rival: The Hushed: free answers ruin their business.

amberhive.name: Amberhive
amberhive.tradeRule: The price goes up every time you trade with them in a row. Loyalty pays.
amberhive.weakness: Split up too long, the swarm forgets how to trade. They travel together in one pod.
amberhive.rival: Greenlings: they eat the flower seeds first.

greenlings.name: Greenlings
greenlings.tradeRule: Pays in seedlings. Hold a seedling three turns and it becomes a full crop worth much more.
greenlings.weakness: Flares. Sprouts survive only in sealed jars.
greenlings.rival: The Kindled: their glow feels like flare-light.

the-forgotten-men.name: The Forgotten Men
the-forgotten-men.tradeRule: Never buys or sells. Show them a copy of your manifest for a small reward; refuse, and they follow you for a turn.
the-forgotten-men.weakness: Without paperwork they’re stuck at port.
the-forgotten-men.rival: Junkwrights: they audit every scrap pile.

junkwrights.name: Junkwrights
junkwrights.tradeRule: Buys broken or spoiled cargo at half price. Anyone’s failed delivery is their profit.
junkwrights.weakness: Their patched suits leak. Long trips need a salvaged canister.

bisola.name: Bisola
bisola.tradeRule: Every deal must be paid in two different goods, never two of the same.
bisola.weakness: Half the family lives under each sun. Someone has to carry goods between the two ports.
bisola.rival: Mimics: they copy the two-color cords and sell them cheaper.

the-hushed.name: The Hushed
the-hushed.tradeRule: Information only. Pay them a secret (a card you’ve seen) to see another player’s hold or the next event.
the-hushed.weakness: A secret told twice is worthless. If a jar opens on the way, the cargo is spoiled.
the-hushed.rival: The Forgotten Men: they want everything written down.

mimics.name: Mimics
mimics.tradeRule: Copies the trade rule of the last species you traded with.
mimics.weakness: With nobody to copy, they slump into a puddle and ride in a pod until they meet someone.
mimics.rival: Bronzeridge: inspectors hate a face that doesn’t match its papers.

starwake-comet.name: Starwake Comet
starwake-comet.tradeRule: Shows up at random each round. Buys anything at a fair price, and sells one face-down mystery crate.
starwake-comet.weakness: It can’t stop. If you miss the rock, it’s gone for the round.
starwake-comet.rival: Edgewardens: the fair never pays the edge toll.
